title: Coverage Extensions Table for Homeowners Insurance
content:
Homeowners Insurance under the HomeShield programs extends the dwelling protection in five ways, and the program decides how far each extension reaches: extended replacement cost, ordinance or law coverage, home systems equipment breakdown, underground service line coverage, and the sewer and drain backup sublimit.

## Extensions by program

| Program | Extended replacement cost | Ordinance or law | Equipment breakdown | Service line (USD) | Sewer and drain backup sublimit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 0 percent | 10 percent of Coverage A | Not included | 0 | 0 |
| HomeShield Standard | 0 percent | 10 percent of Coverage A | Not included | 0 | 5,000 (5000) |
| HomeShield Plus | 25 percent | 10 percent of Coverage A | Included | 10,000 (10000) | 10,000 (10000) |
| HomeShield Preferred | 25 percent | 25 percent of Coverage A | Included | 10,000 (10000) | 15,000 (15000) |
| HomeShield Premier | 50 percent | 25 percent of Coverage A | Included | 25,000 (25000) | 25,000 (25000) |
| HomeShield Estate | 50 percent | 50 percent of Coverage A | Included | 25,000 (25000) | 50,000 (50000) |

## What each column means

- **Extended replacement cost** is extra dwelling coverage, above Coverage A, available after a total loss, stated as a percentage. A figure of 0 percent means no extra dwelling coverage above Coverage A.
- **Ordinance or law** is stated as a percentage of Coverage A.
- **Equipment breakdown** is home systems equipment breakdown coverage; the table states only whether it is included.
- **Service line** is underground service line coverage, in dollars. A figure of 0 means the program carries none.
- **Sewer and drain backup** is a sublimit, in dollars. A figure of 0 means the program carries none.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical Coverage A)

For a hypothetical HomeShield Premier policy with Coverage A of 900,000 dollars:

- extended replacement cost of 50 percent makes up to 450,000 dollars of extra dwelling coverage available after a total loss;
- ordinance or law coverage of 25 percent of Coverage A is 225,000 dollars.

For a hypothetical HomeShield Plus policy with Coverage A of 500,000 dollars, extended replacement cost of 25 percent is up to 125,000 dollars, and ordinance or law coverage of 10 percent of Coverage A is 50,000 dollars.

## Points of reading

- HomeShield Essential and HomeShield Standard include neither equipment breakdown nor service line coverage, and neither carries extended replacement cost.
- Sewer and drain backup first appears under HomeShield Standard, at 5,000 dollars.
